function GetItems(plr,type,minprice,maxprice) --return all possible items that can be awarded - if 0, award furniture instead
	local data = game.ReplicatedStorage.PlayerData:FindFirstChild(plr.userId)
	if data then
		local possibleitems = {}
		for _,v in pairs(game.ReplicatedStorage.Objects:GetChildren()) do
			if v.Name:match(type.."_") and v.ItemCost.Value >= minprice and v.ItemCost.Value <= maxprice and not data.Objects:FindFirstChild(v.ItemID.Value) and not v:FindFirstChild("NotForSale") and not v:FindFirstChild("TwitterCode") and not (v:FindFirstChild("ReleaseTime") and v.ReleaseTime.Value > game.ReplicatedStorage.IntroGUIData.CurrentTime.Value) and not (v:FindFirstChild("TimeToGoOffSale") and v.TimeToGoOffSale.Value < game.ReplicatedStorage.IntroGUIData.CurrentTime.Value) then
				table.insert(possibleitems,v)
			end
		end
		return possibleitems
	end
end


--all these functions return the item's full table for going into the prize table


function GetFurniture(plr,minprice,maxprice,tier) --select random furniture based on price, and return table
	local possibleitems = {}
	for _,v in pairs(game.ReplicatedStorage.Objects:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name:match("furni_") and v.ItemCost.Value >= minprice and v.ItemCost.Value <= maxprice and not v:FindFirstChild("NotForSale") and not v:FindFirstChild("TwitterCode") then
			table.insert(possibleitems,v)
		end
	end
	local item = possibleitems[math.random(1,#possibleitems)]
	local tbl = {
		["ItemName"] = string.sub(item.Name,7),
		["ItemID"] = item.ItemID.Value,
		["ImageID"] = "http://www.roblox.com/Thumbs/Asset.ashx?width=75&height=75&assetId=".. item.ModelID.Value,
		["PrizeTier"] = tier,
		["IsCash"] = false
	}
	return tbl
end

function GetPermanentItem(plr,item,tier) --return table for perm. gear/pets
	local tbl = {
		["ItemName"] = string.sub(item.Name,6),
		["ItemID"] = item.ItemID.Value,
		["ImageID"] = "rbxassetid://"..item.DecalID.Value,
		["PrizeTier"] = tier,
		["IsCash"] = false
	}
	return tbl
end

function GetCash(plr,amount,tier) --return table for cash amt
	local imgid = (tier == 3 and "rbxassetid://343339178" or tier == 4 and "rbxassetid://343339188" or "rbxassetid://343339162")
	local rareitemname
	if tier == 4 then
		rareitemname = "$100,000 Cash Jackpot!"
	end
	local tbl = {
		["ItemName"] = rareitemname or "+$"..amount.." RHS Cash",
		["ItemID"] = amount,
		["ImageID"] = imgid,
		["PrizeTier"] = tier,
		["IsCash"] = true
	}
	return tbl
end


--[[format of spin prize table:
	{  {"ItemName" = "Generic Item Name", "ItemID" = 210, "ImageID" = "rbxassetid://12345678", "PrizeTier" = 1, "IsCash" = false}, [...]  }
	if IsCash, then ItemID is the amount
--]]


--[[
Wheel Prizes:
	Mid-tier furniture (220-520) (COMMON)
	250-400 RHS Cash ($25 increments) (COMMON) (less likely to appear on wheel)
	Higher-tier furniture (500-900) (UNCOMMON) (most common)
	Gear (150-900) (UNCOMMON) (less likely to appear on wheel)
	Pets (250-1200) (UNCOMMON) (hardly ever on wheel)
	Rare furniture (Void, expensive goldens) (RARE)
	High-tier gear (1000-3000) (RARE)
	1000-2500 RHS Cash ($250 increments) (RARE) (unlikely to appear on wheel)
	$100,000 RHS Cash Jackpot (ULTRA-RARE)
--]]



function GetPrize(plr,tier)
	if tier == 1 then
		
		local chance = math.random(1,11)
		if chance <= 7 then --furniture 200-520
			return GetFurniture(plr,200,520,tier)
		else --cash 250-400 ($25 incs.)
			return GetCash(plr,225 + 25 * math.random(1,9),tier)
		end
		
	elseif tier == 2 then
		
		local chance = math.random(1,21)
		local possiblepets = GetItems(plr,"pets",250,1200)
		local possiblegear = GetItems(plr,"gear",150,900)
		if chance >= 12 and chance <= 18 and #possiblegear > 0 then
			return GetPermanentItem(plr,possiblegear[math.random(1,#possiblegear)],tier)
		elseif chance >= 19 and chance <= 21 and #possiblepets > 0 then
			return GetPermanentItem(plr,possiblepets[math.random(1,#possiblepets)],tier)
		else
			return GetFurniture(plr,500,950,tier)
		end
		
	elseif tier == 3 then
		
		local chance = math.random(1,10)
		local possiblegear = GetItems(plr,"gear",1000,3000)
		if chance >= 5 and chance <= 9 and #possiblegear > 0 then
			return GetPermanentItem(plr,possiblegear[math.random(1,#possiblegear)],tier)
		elseif chance == 10 then
			return GetCash(plr,750 + 250 * math.random(1,7),tier)
		else
			return GetFurniture(plr,1000,4200,tier)
		end
		
	elseif tier == 4 then
		return GetCash(plr,100000,tier)
	end
end

local numberofprizes = {9,6,2,1} --each prize tier

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.FetchSpinPrizeTable.OnServerInvoke = function(plr) --generate a player prize table, insert it into this server-side table, then send it to the client to use
	local data = game.ReplicatedStorage.PlayerData:FindFirstChild(plr.userId)
	if data and data:FindFirstChild("LoyaltyStats") and data.LoyaltyStats.Spins.Value > 0 then
		local prizetable = {}
		for i,v in pairs(numberofprizes) do
			for x = 1,v do --pick out prizes for this tier
				table.insert(prizetable,GetPrize(plr,i))
			end
		end
		playerprizetables[plr.Name] = prizetable
		for x,tb in pairs(prizetable) do
			print("TABLE "..x)
			for i,v in pairs(tb) do
				print(i,v)
			end
			print("----------------------------------------")
		end
		return prizetable
	end
end

function WaitForWheelStop(plr,itemtable)
	coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
		local enabled = true
		local connection
		connection = game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.PrizeWheelStopped.OnServerEvent:connect(function(firer)
			local data = game.ReplicatedStorage.PlayerData:FindFirstChild(plr.userId)
			if firer == plr and enabled and data then
				enabled = false
				connection:disconnect()
				if itemtable["IsCash"] == false then
					AddItemToData(plr,itemtable["ItemID"])
				else
					data.cash.Value = data.cash.Value + itemtable["ItemID"]
					
					--analytics
					if itemtable["ItemID"] == 100000 then
						game.ServerStorage.AnalyticsCache.CashEarned.Jackpot.Value = game.ServerStorage.AnalyticsCache.CashEarned.Jackpot.Value + 100000
					else
						game.ServerStorage.AnalyticsCache.CashEarned.PrizeSpin.Value = game.ServerStorage.AnalyticsCache.CashEarned.PrizeSpin.Value + itemtable["ItemID"]
					end
				end
				print("Successfully awarded prize "..itemtable["ItemName"]..", ID "..itemtable["ItemID"]..", to "..plr.Name)
			end
		end)
	end))
end

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.FetchWinningSpinPrize.OnServerInvoke = function(plr) --randomly select a winning prize from the player's prize table, then send the winning index back to the client - reduce player's spins by 1
	local tbl = playerprizetables[plr.Name]
	local data = game.ReplicatedStorage.PlayerData:FindFirstChild(plr.userId)
	if tbl ~= nil and data and data:FindFirstChild("LoyaltyStats") and data.LoyaltyStats.Spins.Value > 0 then
		playerprizetables[plr.Name] = nil
		local tierchance = math.random(1,10000)
		local tier = 1
		if tierchance <= 5200 then
			tier = 1
		elseif tierchance >= 5201 and tierchance <= 9350 then
			tier = 2
		elseif tierchance >= 9351 and tierchance <= 9999 then
			tier = 3
		elseif tierchance == 10000 then
			tier = 4
		end
		print("Tier Chance: "..tierchance.." ... Prize Tier: "..tier)
		
		local availableindicies = {}
		
		for i,itemtable in pairs(tbl) do
			if itemtable["PrizeTier"] == tier then
				table.insert(availableindicies,i)
			end
		end
		
		data.LoyaltyStats.Spins.Value = data.LoyaltyStats.Spins.Value - 1
		
		local index = availableindicies[math.random(1,#availableindicies)] --winner!
		--now a function that will wait for the client's wheel to stop spinning to award the prize
		WaitForWheelStop(plr,tbl[index])
		
		print("Index "..index.." selected, player will win "..tbl[index]["ItemName"])
		return index
	end
endd
--- chunk=595 type=PROP offset=416574 chars=3428 ---
function getTime()
	local suffix = "AM"
	local tod = game.Lighting.TimeOfDay
	local day = game.ReplicatedStorage.Day.Value
	local hours = tonumber(string.sub(tod,1,2))
	local mins = tonumber(string.sub(tod,4,5))
	if hours > 12 then
		hours = hours - 12
		suffix = "PM"
	elseif hours < 12 and hours > 0 then
		suffix = "AM"
	elseif hours == 12 then
		suffix = "PM"
	elseif hours == 0 then
		hours = 12
		suffix = "AM"
	end
	local minsstring = mins
	if mins < 10 then
		minsstring = "0"..mins
	end
	local daystring
	if day == 1 then
		daystring = "Sun"
	elseif day == 2 then
		daystring = "Mon"
	elseif day == 3 then
		daystring = "Tue"
	elseif day == 4 then
		daystring = "Wed"
	elseif day == 5 then
		daystring = "Thur"
	elseif day == 6 then
		daystring = "Fri"
	elseif day == 7 then
		daystring = "Sat"
	end
	return daystring.." "..hours..":"..minsstring.." "..suffix
end

local chat = game:GetService("Chat")

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.SendTextMessage.OnServerInvoke = function(plr,targetplr,thread,input)
	
	local flag1
	pcall(function()
		flag1 = game:GetService("Chat"):CanUserChatAsync(plr.userId)
	end)
	if not flag1 then return end
	
	local flag
	pcall(function()
		flag = game:GetService("Chat"):CanUsersChatAsync(plr.userId, targetplr.userId)
	end)
	if not flag then
		game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NotificationForClient:FireClient(plr, "This user's Roblox privacy settings prevent you from messaging them.")
		return
	end
	
	local filteredstring
	pcall(function()
		filteredstring = chat:FilterStringAsync(input,plr,targetplr)
	end)
	if filteredstring == nil then return end
	
	if targetplr and targetplr.Parent ~= nil and targetplr:FindFirstChild("textingdata") then
		if not targetplr.textingdata.blocklist:FindFirstChild(plr.Name) then
			if not targetplr.textingdata.messages:FindFirstChild(plr.Name) then
				local threadmark = script.thread:clone()
				threadmark.Name = plr.Name
				threadmark.Parent = targetplr.textingdata.messages
			end
			if not plr.textingdata.messages:FindFirstChild(targetplr.Name) then
				local localthreadm = script.thread:clone()
				localthreadm.Name = targetplr.Name
				localthreadm.Parent = plr.textingdata.messages
			end
			local thread = targetplr.textingdata.messages:FindFirstChild(plr.Name)
			local localthread = plr.textingdata.messages:FindFirstChild(targetplr.Name)
			if thread then
				local msg = Instance.new("StringValue")
				msg.Name = plr.Name
				msg.Value = filteredstring
				msg.Parent = thread
				local timeval = getTime()
				thread.timestamp.Value = timeval
				game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.TextReceived:FireClient(targetplr,thread,msg)
				
			end
			if localthread then
				local msg = Instance.new("StringValue")
				msg.Name = plr.Name
				msg.Value = filteredstring
				msg.Parent = localthread
				local timeval = getTime()
				localthread.timestamp.Value = timeval
			end
			return true
		else
			return false,"Error: Player has blocked you"
		end
	else
		return false,"Error: Player has left"
	end
end

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.ToggleBlockedPhoneContact.OnServerInvoke = function(plr,targetplr)
	local blocklist = plr.textingdata.blocklist
	if blocklist:FindFirstChild(targetplr.Name) then
		blocklist[targetplr.Name]:Destroy()
		return false --wasblocked = false
	else
		local blocker = Instance.new("IntValue")
		blocker.Name = targetplr.Name
		blocker.Parent = blocklist
		return true
	end
end

function CreateFakeBoard()

			v:Destroy()
		end

	FakeBoard.CanCollide = false
	local BoardMesh = Mesh:Clone()

	local FakeBoardWeld = Instance.new("Weld") 
	FakeBoardWeld.Parent = FakeBoard
	FakeBoardWeld.Part0 = Board
	FakeBoardWeld.Part1 = FakeBoard
	FakeBoardWeld.C0 = CFrame.new(0, 0, 0)
	FakeBoard.Parent = Board
	Board.Transparency = 1
end

function CheckIfAlive()
	return (((Player and Player.Parent and Humanoid and Humanoid.Parent and Humanoid.Health > 0) and true) or false)
end

end

local banned = {}

function GetPlayer(str,admin)
	if str == nil or string == "" then return end
	if str == "me" then return admin end
	for _,plr in pairs(game.Players:GetChildren()) do
		if string.sub(string.lower(plr.Name),1,#str) == string.lower(str) and plr.Name ~= "Cindering" then
			return plr
		end
	end
end

game.Players.PlayerAdded:connect(function(plr)
	if game.VIPServerOwnerId == plr.userId then
		plr.Chatted:connect(function(msg)
			if string.sub(msg,1,6) == "/kick " then
				local target = GetPlayer(string.sub(msg,7),plr)
				if target and target ~= plr then
					game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NotificationForClient:FireClient(plr,"Kicked user "..target.Name..".")
					target:Kick()
				end
			elseif string.sub(msg,1,5) == "/ban " then
				local target = GetPlayer(string.sub(msg,6),plr)
				if target and target ~= plr then
					table.insert(banned,target.Name)
					game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NotificationForClient:FireClient(plr,"Banned user "..target.Name.." from this session.")
					target:Kick()
				end
			elseif string.sub(msg,1,7) == "/unban " then
				local index
				local targetname
				local str = string.sub(msg,8)
				if str and str ~= "" then
					for i,v in pairs(banned) do
						if string.sub(string.lower(v),1,#str) == string.lower(str) then
							index = i
							targetname = v
						end
					end
					if index then
						table.remove(banned,index)
						game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NotificationForClient:FireClient(plr,"Unbanned user "..targetname..".")
					end
				end
			elseif string.sub(msg,1,6) == "/kill " then
				local target = GetPlayer(string.sub(msg,7),plr)
				if target then
					local char = target.Character
					if char and char:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
						char.Humanoid.Health = 0
						game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NotificationForClient:FireClient(plr,"Killed user "..target.Name..".")
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		
		wait(30)
		game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NotificationForClient:FireClient(plr, "Welcome! As the owner of this VIP server, you have access to the following admin commands: /kick [plr], /ban [plr], /unban [plr], and /kill [plr]. Use these to handle any disruptive players. Enjoy!",true)
	end
	for _,v in pairs(banned) do
		if v == plr.Name then
			plr:Kick()
		end
	end
end)V1

local seatchecker --the coroutine protecting from position changes

function regenSeats()
	if game.Workspace:FindFirstChild("RegenSeats") then
		game.Workspace.RegenSeats:Destroy()
	end
	wait(1)
	local newseats = seatsmodel:clone()
	newseats.Parent = game.Workspace
	newseats:MakeJoints()
	local positiontable = {}
	for _,v in pairs(newseats:GetChildren()) do
		table.insert(positiontable,v.CFrame)
	end
	if seatchecker then
		coroutine.yield(seatchecker)
	end
	seatchecker = coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
		for i,v in pairs(newseats:GetChildren()) do
			v.Changed:connect(function(property)
				if property == "Position" then
					v.CFrame = positiontable[i]
				end
			end)
		end
	end),newseats,positiontable)
end

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.ChangeClassSchedule.OnServerInvoke = function(plr,periodnumber,classname)
	if enforcer.Value == plr then
		local currenttime = t:GetMinutesAfterMidnight()
		if (currenttime < 390 or currenttime > 900) or (day.Value == 1 or day.Value == 7) then
			local period = schedule["P"..periodnumber]
			for _,v in pairs(schedule:GetChildren()) do
				if v.Value == classname then --swap the 2 classes
					v.Value = period.Value
				end
			end
			period.Value = classname
			return true
		else
			return false
		end
	end
end

				end
				if color ~= nil then
					v.Effect.Color = color
					if v:FindFirstChild("PointLight") then
						v.PointLight.Color = color
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

-- Turn off the machines, activated whenever the first song in the queue is removed

function turnOffMachines()
	for i,v in pairs(djstand:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "FireMachine" then
			v.Effect.Enabled = false
			v.PointLight.Enabled = false
		elseif v.Name == "SmokeMachine" then
			v.Effect.Enabled = false
		end
	end
end

-- Handle requests to Favorite songs (ID passed as parameter; add fav if it doesn't exist, delete fav if it does)

function ToggleFavoriteSong(plr, id)
	local list
	local changes
	local data
	
	data = game.ReplicatedStorage.PlayerData:FindFirstChild(plr.userId)
	if data then
		data = data.SongLists
		list = data.Favorites
		changes = data.FavoriteChanges
		
		local changeremoved
		
		local change = changes:FindFirstChild(id)
		if change then
			change:Destroy()
			changeremoved = true
		end
		
		--see whether to add or remove favorite
		local entry = list:FindFirstChild(id)
		
		if entry == nil and #list:GetChildren() >= 100 then return end --can't add any more
		
		if not changeremoved then
			local marker = Instance.new("BoolValue",changes)
			marker.Name = id
			marker.Value = entry == nil and true or false
		end
		if entry then
			--remove favorite
			entry:Destroy()
		else
			--add favorite
			local marker2 = Instance.new("StringValue",list)
			marker2.Name = id
		end
	end
end

-- Add song to Recently Played list (if song is already on list, make a clone and delete original)
-- (removing children from the folder and reparenting them places them at the end of the list)

function AddToRecentlyPlayed(plr, id)
	local list
	local changes
	local data
	
	data = game.ReplicatedStorage.PlayerData:FindFirstChild(plr.userId)
	if data then
		data = data.SongLists
		list = data.RecentlyPlayed
		changes = data.RecentChanges
		
		--add to recently played
		local entry = list:FindFirstChild(id)
		
		local marker = Instance.new("BoolValue",changes)
		marker.Name = id
		marker.Value = true
		
		if entry then
			entry:Destroy()
		end
		
		--add marker to list, parent everything else outside of folder to let new song be at top of list
		for _,v in pairs(list:GetChildren()) do
			v.Parent = script.TempObjectHolder
		end
		local marker2 = Instance.new("StringValue",list)
		marker2.Name = id
		--move objects back into list, but remove any excess songs past 30
		for i,v in pairs(script.TempObjectHolder:GetChildren()) do
			if i < 29 then
				v.Parent = list
			else
				local removal = Instance.new("BoolValue",changes)
				removal.Name = id
				removal.Value = false
				v:Destroy()
			end
		end
	end
end

	if game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.GamePassCheck:Invoke(plr,"UnrestrictedDJ") == true and #tostring(id) < 15 then
		ToggleFavoriteSong(plr, id)
	end
end)

-- Add a song (which has already been checked for validity) to the end of the queue. The sound passed is from the validation function which creates the sound.
-- Returns: success (bool), error message if any

function AddSongToQueue(plr, sound, HasUDJ)
	if not (plr and sound) then
		return false, "Error while adding song to queue. Please try again."
	end
	
	local id_digits = sound.SoundId:match("%d+")
	
	if not id_digits then
		return false, "Error while adding song to queue. Please try again."
	end
	
	sound.Volume = 0
	
	local data = Instance.new("Folder")
	data.Name = sound.Name
	
	local id = Instance.new("IntValue", data)
	id.Name = "SongID"
	id.Value = id_digits
	
	local pid = Instance.new("IntValue", data)
	pid.Name = "PlayerID"
	pid.Value = plr.userId
	
	local pname = Instance.new("StringValue", data)
	pname.Name = "PlayerName"
	pname.Value = plr.Name
	
	local queuepos = Instance.new("IntValue", data)
	queuepos.Name = "QueuePosition"
	queuepos.Value = #queue + 1
	
	local queueitem = {
		["PlayerName"] = plr.Name,
		["PlayerID"] = plr.userId,
		["SongID"] = sound.SoundId,
		["SongName"] = sound.Name,
		["HasUnrestrictedDJ"] = HasUDJ,
		["SoundObject"] = sound,
		["QueueObject"] = data,
	}
	
	table.insert(queue, queueitem)
	
	if HasUDJ then
		AddToRecentlyPlayed(plr, tostring(id_digits))
	end
	
	data.Parent = game.ReplicatedStorage.SongQueueItems
	sound.Parent = game.ServerStorage.ServerSoundStorage
	
	if queuepos.Value == 1 then
		game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NextSongInQueue:FireAllClients(data)
	end
	
	if sound.TimeLength > 179 and not HasUDJ then
		return true, math.floor(sound.TimeLength)
	end
	
	return true
end

-- Remove a song from queue position n, shifting the queue position of all upcoming songs forward.

function DeleteSongFromQueue(n)
	local queueitem = queue[n]
	if queueitem == nil then return end
	
	local sound = queueitem.SoundObject
	local queueobj = queueitem.QueueObject
	if not (sound and queueobj) then return end
	
	local nextsong
	
	for _,s in pairs(game.ReplicatedStorage.SongQueueItems:GetChildren()) do
		if s.QueuePosition.Value > n then
			s.QueuePosition.Value = s.QueuePosition.Value - 1
			if s.QueuePosition.Value == 1 then
				nextsong = s 
			end
		end
	end
	
	sound:Destroy()
	queueobj:Destroy()
	
	if n == 1 then
		turnOffMachines()
		game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NextSongInQueue:FireAllClients(nextsong)
	end
	
	table.remove(queue, n)
end

-- Validate whether a song can be played - part of the process of a player submitting a song request to the server.
-- Returns: sound object, success (bool) and an error message, if any.

function ValidateSong(plr, songid)
	local songname
	
	local asset
	pcall(function() asset = game:GetService("MarketplaceService"):GetProductInfo(songid) end)
	if asset == nil then
		return nil, false, "This ID is invalid and could not be loaded."
	end
	songname = asset.Name
	
	--validate whether the asset fits the appropriate categories to be played
	
	if asset.AssetTypeId ~= 3 then
		return nil, false, "This is not a valid ID for an audio file."
	end

	if asset.IsPublicDomain == false then
		return nil, false, "This audio file is not available in the public domain."
	end	
	--create the sound, wait for the audio file to be fully loaded and check the length
	
	local sound = Instance.new("Sound", game.ServerStorage)
	sound.Name = songname
	sound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://"..songid
	sound.Looped = true
	sound.Volume = 0
	
	local i = 0
	repeat
		wait(1/30)
		i = i + 1
	until sound.IsLoaded or i >= 240
	
	if not sound.IsLoaded then
		-- sound took too long to load 
		return sound, false, "Server failed to load this song. Please try again later."
	end
	
	if sound.TimeLength < 29 then
		return sound, false, "Songs must be longer than 30 seconds long."
	end
	
	return sound, true
end

-- Checks whether the queue has free space, whether the player is allowed to add more songs to the queue, whether the song ID is already in the queue, and whether the person is banned from adding songs
-- Returns: success (bool) and an error message, if any

function CheckQueueStatus(plr, songid, num_songs_allowed)
	if #queue >= 10 then
		return false, "The song queue is currently full. Please try again later!"
	end
	
	local songcount = 0
	
	for _,id in pairs(banned_userIDs) do
		if plr.userId == id then
			return false, "You have been temporarily restricted due to playing very loud audio."
		end
	end
	
	for _,data in pairs(queue) do
		if data.SongID:match("%d+") == songid then
			return false, "This song is already in the queue. Please pick a different one."
		elseif data.PlayerID == plr.userId then
			songcount = songcount + 1
		end
	end
	
	if songcount >= num_songs_allowed then
		if num_songs_allowed == 2 then
			return false, "Please wait for another one of your songs to finish playing."
		else
			return false, "The Unrestricted DJ pass is required to queue 2 songs at once."
		end
	end
	
	return true
end

-- When the client says it has purchased the UDJ pass, wait and see if that is actually true.

function ValidateUDJPurchase(plr)
	local HasUDJ
	local i = 0
	repeat
		wait(1/3)
		i = i + 1
		HasUDJ = check:Invoke(plr,"UnrestrictedDJ")
	until HasUDJ or i >= 15
	
	return HasUDJ
end

-- Handles the network request from the player requesting to add a song to the queue. Main function responsible for adding songs.
-- Returns: success (bool) and an error message, if any, to the client.

function RequestSong(plr, songid)
	local HasCR = check:Invoke(plr,"ClubRed")
	local HasUDJ = check:Invoke(plr,"UnrestrictedDJ")
	
	if HasCR or HasUDJ then
		--player has pass
		
		--check if this song ID is allowed to be placed in the queue by this user 
		local success, reason, doprompt = CheckQueueStatus(plr, songid, (HasUDJ and 2 or 1))
		
		if not success then
			return success, reason
		end
		
		--validate the song 
		local sound, success, reason = ValidateSong(plr, songid)
		
		if not (sound and success) then
			--failed to validate song; destroy the sound and return the reason to the player
			if sound then
				sound:Destroy()
			end
			return success, reason
		end
		
		
		-- Call the queue checking function again just in case, and add the song to the queue.
		local success, reason, doprompt = CheckQueueStatus(plr, songid, (HasUDJ and 2 or 1))
		
		if not success then
			return success, reason
		end
		
		-- Everything's good. Add the song to the queue.
		
		return AddSongToQueue(plr, sound, HasUDJ)
		
	else
		-- exploiter
		return false, "Nope."
	end
end

-- Remotefunction handling song ID requests to add to the queue.

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.RequestDJSong.OnServerInvoke = function(plr, songid)
	return RequestSong(plr, songid)
end


-- List of requests from players saying that the current song is too loud.
local tooloudrequests = {}

-- RemoteEvent that listens for clients saying that the current song is too loud

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.FlagSong.OnServerEvent:connect(function(plr)
	-- check if requesting player is already on list
	for _,v in pairs(tooloudrequests) do
		if v == plr.userId then
			return
		end
	end
	
	if #queue > 0 then
		table.insert(tooloudrequests, plr.userId)
	end
end)

-- Function that allows the main loop to check whether the song is flagged as too loud (575+ loudness)

function SongIsTooLoud(currentsong)
	if #tooloudrequests >= 6 then
		return true
	end
	
	for _,v in pairs(tooloudrequests) do
		if v == currentsong.PlayerID then
			return true
		end
	end
	
	return false
end

-- Add a user to the banned_userIDs table if they have played a very loud song 

function AddUserToBannedList(pid)
	coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(function()
		table.insert(banned_userIDs, pid)
		wait(185)
		table.remove(banned_userIDs, 1)
	end))
end


-- Run the loop which manages the playing, timing, and removal of songs

local currentsong --points to the table entry of the current song that's playing
local targettime --the amount of time the song is allowed to play
local elapsedtime = 0

game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.GetTimeOfSong.OnServerInvoke = function(plr)
	if currentsong and currentsong.SoundObject then
		return currentsong.SoundObject.TimePosition
	end
end

-- If player purchases UDJ, set their songs to UDJ true.

game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.SetSongsInQueueToUDJ.Event:connect(function(plr)
	for _,queueitem in pairs(queue) do
		if queueitem["PlayerName"] == plr.Name then
			queueitem["HasUDJ"] = true
		end
	end
	if currentsong and currentsong["PlayerName"] == plr.Name and currentsong.SoundObject then
		--set currently playing song to appropriate length
		targettime = currentsong.SoundObject.TimeLength - 3
		if targettime > 418 then
			targettime = 417
		end
	end
end)

--debuggin purposes
game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.PrintBannedDJs.Event:connect(function()
	for _,v in pairs(banned_userIDs) do
		print(game.Players:GetPlayerByUserId(v))
	end
end)

while true do
	local time_passed = wait()
	
	-- If there is a new song in position 1 of the queue, set that to the current song
	if currentsong ~= queue[1] then
		elapsedtime = 0
		oldtime = 0
		if #queue > 0 then
			currentsong = queue[1]
			wait(2.7)
			tooloudrequests = {}
		end
	end
	
	-- Keep checking the current song's conditions
	if currentsong then
		elapsedtime = elapsedtime + time_passed
		
		local sound = currentsong.SoundObject
		if sound then
			if not sound.IsPlaying then
				-- Initialize the song to be played
				sound:Play()
				
				if sound.TimeLength > 120 and not currentsong.HasUnrestrictedDJ then
					targettime = 117
				else
					targettime = sound.TimeLength - 3
					if targettime > 418 then
						targettime = 417
					end
				end
			end
			
			if elapsedtime >= targettime then
				-- End the current song
				DeleteSongFromQueue(1)
				currentsong = nil
			end
			
			if currentsong and SongIsTooLoud(currentsong) then
				-- Punish user if their song is too loud
				local pid = currentsong.PlayerID
				local player = game.Players:FindFirstChild(currentsong.PlayerName)
				if player then
					game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NotificationForClient:FireClient(player, "Warning: Do not play extremely loud audio! Please preview your songs before playing them to make sure they are not loud or distorted.", true)
				end
				AddUserToBannedList(currentsong.PlayerID)
				DeleteSongFromQueue(1)
				currentsong = nil
				for i,v in pairs(queue) do
					if v.PlayerID == pid then
						DeleteSongFromQueue(i)
					end
				end
			end
			
		end
		
	end
end

--routinely push the stats to the GA module

--the push functions (which can also be utilized during OnClose)

function PushShopPurchases()
	for _,v in pairs(game.ServerStorage.AnalyticsCache.ShopPurchases:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Value > 0 then
			local shopname = string.gsub(v.Name,"%W","")
			GA:SendEvent(
				{
					["category"] = "resource",
					["event_id"] = "Source:FoodCount:"..shopname..":Count",
					["amount"] = v.Value
				}
			)
			v.Value = 0
		end
	end
end

function PushTimeSpent()
	for _,v in pairs(game.ServerStorage.AnalyticsCache.TimeSpent:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Value > 2 then
			local shopname = string.gsub(v.Name,"%W","")
			local timeval = math.floor(v.Value / 3)
			GA:SendEvent(
				{
					["category"] = "resource",
					["event_id"] = "Source:TimeSpent:"..shopname..":Mins",
					["amount"] = timeval
				}
			)
			v.Value = 0
		end
	end
end

function PushCashEarned()
	for _,v in pairs(game.ServerStorage.AnalyticsCache.CashEarned:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Value > 0 then
			local shopname = string.gsub(v.Name,"%W","")
			GA:SendEvent(
				{
					["category"] = "resource",
					["event_id"] = "Source:Cash:"..shopname..":Earnings",
					["amount"] = v.Value
				}
			)
			v.Value = 0
		end
	end
end

function MoveOrb()
	local origin = orb.Position
	local targetpos = orb.Position + Vector3.new(math.random(-maxmovedistance, maxmovedistance), math.random(0,6), math.random(-maxmovedistance, maxmovedistance))
	local mag = (origin - targetpos).magnitude
	local ray1 = Ray.new(origin, (targetpos - origin).unit * mag)

	local hit,destination
	
	local ignorelist = {orb}
	
	hit,destination = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray1,ignorelist)
	if hit then
		destination = destination - ray1.Unit.Direction * 2.5
	end

	local ray2 = Ray.new(destination, ((destination - Vector3.new(0,50,0)) - destination).unit * 50)
	local hit2,destination2
	hit2,destination2 = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray2,ignorelist)
	if destination2 then
		destination = destination2 + Vector3.new(0,(math.random(27,35)/10),0)
	end

	bp.Position = destination
end

while orb do
	wait(interval + (math.random(-25,25)/100))
	if orb and enabled then
		MoveOrb()
	end

function NotifyOwner(invader)
	if notificationsenabled then
		notificationsenabled = false
		local ownername = string.sub(script.Parent.Parent.Name:match("_.+"),2)
		if ownername then
			local owner = game.Players:FindFirstChild(ownername)
			if owner then
				game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NotificationForClient:FireClient(owner, invader.Name.." tried to enter your house, but you are still in Edit Mode. (Save & Exit to allow visitors to enter)")
			end
		end
		wait(75)
		notificationsenabled = true
	end

function SendMessage(plr)
	if msgenabled then
		msgenabled = false
		game.ReplicatedStorage.RemoteFunctions.NotificationForClient:FireClient(plr,"You are restricted from entering the house at this time. The owner may be in Edit Mode.")
		wait(2)
		msgenabled = true
	end
end

function onHit(hit)
	if hit then
		if hit.Parent.Name:match("vehicle_") then
			game.ServerStorage.RemoteFunctions.DestroyCar:Fire(hit.Parent,"It's not very polite to smash your car into other people's houses!")
		else
			local plr = game.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(hit.Parent)
			if plr ~= nil then
				if plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
					if (editing.Value == true and plr.Name ~= string.sub(script.Parent.Parent.Name,7)) or (restrictions.Value == true and not restrictions:FindFirstChild(plr.Name) and plr.Name ~= string.sub(script.Parent.Parent.Name,7)) then
						plr.Character.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame = script.Parent.Parent.Door.CFrame + (script.Parent.Parent.Door.CFrame.lookVector * 10)
						
						coroutine.resume(coroutine.create(SendMessage),plr)

						if editing.Value == true then
							NotifyOwner(plr)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

	if v.Name:match("Floor%d+") or v.Name == "ExteriorWall" or v.Name == "Ceiling" or v.Name == "Door" then

			onHit(hit)
		end)
	end

function DropSkateboard()
	
	local MousePosition = InvokeClient("MousePosition")
	
	local DesiredAngle = (math.acos((MousePosition - Handle.Position).unit:Dot(Torso.CFrame.lookVector)))
	if DesiredAngle > (math.pi / 2) then --Prevents spawning behind character.
		--return
	end
	
	local SkateboardSize = Skateboard:GetModelSize()	
	
	local Direction = CFrame.new(Torso.Position, Vector3.new(MousePosition.X, Torso.Position.Y, MousePosition.Z))
	local SkateboardCFrame = Direction + Direction.lookVector * (((Torso.Size.Z / 2) + (SkateboardSize.Z / 2)) * 1.5)
	local SkateboardAngle = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)
	
	local RayOffset = Vector3.new(-1.5, 0, -1.5)
	
	local RayPoints = { --Border points and center of skateboard used for casting rays.
		Center = Functions.PositionPart(SkateboardCFrame, 0, 0, 0),
		BackLeft = Functions.PositionPart(SkateboardCFrame, -((SkateboardSize.X / 2) + RayOffset.X), RayOffset.Y, -((SkateboardSize.Z / 2) + RayOffset.Z)),
		BackRight = Functions.PositionPart(SkateboardCFrame, ((SkateboardSize.X / 2) + RayOffset.X), RayOffset.Y, -((SkateboardSize.Z / 2) + RayOffset.Z)),
		FrontLeft = Functions.PositionPart(SkateboardCFrame, -((SkateboardSize.X / 2) + RayOffset.X), RayOffset.Y, ((SkateboardSize.Z / 2) + RayOffset.Z)),
		FrontRight = Functions.PositionPart(SkateboardCFrame, ((SkateboardSize.X / 2) + RayOffset.X), RayOffset.Y, ((SkateboardSize.Z / 2) + RayOffset.Z)),
	}
	
	local RayData = {
		Area = { --Cast ray to determine if skateboard will spawn inside something.
			Offset = Vector3.new(0, (SkateboardSize.Y / 2), 0),
			Direction = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0),
			Distance = SkateboardSize.Y
		},
		Ground = { --Cast ray to determine if the skateboard can spawn on the ground.
			Direction = Vector3.new(0, -1, 0),
			Distance = (SkateboardSize.Y * 4)
		}
	}
	
	local Ignore = {Character, Skateboard}
	
	local HighestGroundRayHit, HighestGroundRayPos --Get the highest point of elevation to spawn the skateboard.
	for i, v in pairs(RayPoints) do
		local GroundRayHit, GroundRayPos = Functions.RayCast(v.p, RayData.Ground.Direction, RayData.Ground.Distance, Ignore)
		if not HighestGroundRayPos or GroundRayPos.Y > HighestGroundRayPos.Y then
			HighestGroundRayHit, HighestGroundRayPos = GroundRayHit, GroundRayPos
		end
	end	
	
	local FullAreaIsEmpty = true --Ensure entire area is empty.
	for i, v in pairs(RayPoints) do
		local AreaIsEmpty = Functions.RegionEmpty((v.p - RayData.Area.Offset), {Min = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Max = (RayData.Area.Direction * RayData.Area.Distance)}, Ignore)
		if not AreaIsEmpty then
			FullAreaIsEmpty = false
		end
	end
	
	if not FullAreaIsEmpty or not HighestGroundRayHit then
		return
	end
	
	ToolEnabled = false
	
	local PosX, PosY, PosZ, R00, R01, R02, R10, R11, R12, R20, R21, R22 = SkateboardCFrame:components()
	SkateboardCFrame = CFrame.new(PosX, (HighestGroundRayPos.Y + (SkateboardSize.Y / 2)), PosZ, R00, R01, R02, R10, R11, R12, R20, R21, R22)
	
	InvokeClient("PlaySound", Sounds.Drop)
	
	Tool.Parent = nil
	
	SkateboardFunctions.SpawnSkateboard(Skateboard, (SkateboardCFrame * SkateboardAngle))

	Debris:AddItem(Tool, 0)	
	Tool:Destroy()
	
end

function CheckIfAlive()
	return (((Player and Player.Parent and Character and Character.Parent and Humanoid and Humanoid.Parent and Humanoid.Health > 0 and Torso and Torso.Parent) and true) or false)
end

function Activated()
	if not ToolEquipped or not ToolEnabled or not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	DropSkateboard()
end

function Equipped()
	Character = Tool.Parent
	Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
	Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	Torso = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or Character:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso")
	if not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	ToolEquipped = true
end

function Unequipped()
	ToolEquipped = false
end

Tool.Activated:connect(Activated)
Tool.Equipped:connect(Equipped)
Tool.Unequipped:connect(Unequipped)

function SetUpRobloxian(Figure)
	local Values = {
		{Name = "Creator", Class = "ObjectValue", Value = Player},
		{Name = "Mode", Class = "StringValue", Value = "Follow"},
		{Name = "MaxDistance", Class = "NumberValue", Value = 150},
		{Name = "Follow", Class = "ObjectValue", Value = Player},
		{Name = "Offset", Class = "Vector3Value", Value = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)},
		{Name = "Target", Class = "ObjectValue", Value = nil},
		{Name = "TargetPos", Class = "Vector3Value", Value = Vector3.new(0, 0, 0)},
		{Name = "Damage", Class = "NumberValue", Value = 0},
	}
	for i, v in pairs(Values) do
		local Value = Create(v.Class){
			Name = v.Name,
			Value = v.Value,
			Parent = Figure,
		}
	end
	local Humanoid = Figure:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	local Torso = Figure:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if Humanoid and Torso then
		Humanoid.Died:connect(function()
			Debris:AddItem(Figure, 2)
		end)
		Humanoid.Jumping:connect(function()
		end)
		Figure.Changed:connect(function(Property)
			if Property == "Parent" and not Figure.Parent then
				Debris:AddItem(Figure, 2)
			end
		end)
	end
	return
end

function SpawnRobloxians()
	RobloxiansReady = false
	CurrentRobloxians = {}
	local RobloxianModel = CreateRobloxianModel()
	RobloxianModel.Changed:connect(function(Property)
		if Property == "Parent" and not RobloxianModel.Parent then
			for i, v in pairs(CurrentRobloxians) do
				if v and v.Parent then
					v:Destroy()
				end
			end
			CurrentRobloxians = {}
			Tool.Enabled = false
			wait(ReloadTime)
			Tool.Enabled = true
			Handle.Transparency = 0
			RobloxiansSpawned = false
		end
	end)	
	Debris:AddItem(RobloxianModel, Duration)
	RobloxianModel.Parent = game:GetService("Workspace")
	local function CreatePawn()
		local Data = NPCModule.GetTable({Key = "MakeNPC", Player = Player})
		if not Data then
			return
		end
		local NPCData = Data.GetData({Player = Player, Tool = Tool})
		local BaseNPC = NPCData.MakeNPC({Scale = 0.5, NameTagHidden = true, Appearance = Character})
		BaseNPC.Name = "ROBLOXian"
		local RobloxianCopy = BaseNPC:Clone()
		local RobloxianHumanoid = RobloxianCopy.Humanoid
		local RobloxianTorso = RobloxianCopy.HumanoidRootPart
		SetUpRobloxian(RobloxianCopy)
		RobloxianCopy.Follow.Value = Character
		table.insert(CurrentRobloxians, RobloxianCopy)
		RobloxianCopy.Changed:connect(function(Property)
			if Property == "Parent" and not RobloxianCopy.Parent then
				for i, v in pairs(CurrentRobloxians) do
					if v == RobloxianCopy then
						table.remove(CurrentRobloxians, i)
						if #CurrentRobloxians == 0 then
							if RobloxianModel and RobloxianModel.Parent then
								Debris:AddItem(RobloxianModel, 1)
								RobloxianModel:Destroy()
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end)
		local OffsetValue = RobloxianCopy.Offset
		OffsetValue.Value = Vector3.new(3, 0, -1.5)
		RobloxianHumanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
		RobloxianHumanoid.MaxHealth = 100
		RobloxianHumanoid.Health = RobloxianHumanoid.MaxHealth
		RobloxianCopy.Parent = RobloxianModel
		RobloxianTorso.CFrame = (Torso.CFrame * CFrame.new(OffsetValue.Value) - Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0))
		RobloxianHumanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall)
	end
	CreatePawn()
	RobloxiansReady = true
end

	local Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Child)
	if Player then
		return
	end
	for i, v in pairs(Figures) do
		if v.Figure == Child then
			return
		end
	end
	local Figure = {Figure = Child, TouchDebounce = false, Connections = {}}
	local Humanoid = Child:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	local Head = Child:FindFirstChild("Head")
	local Torso = Child:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not Humanoid or not Humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or Humanoid.Health == 0 or not Head or not Torso then
		return
	end
	local Neck = Torso:FindFirstChild("Neck")
	if not Neck then
		return
	end
	for i, v in pairs({Humanoid, Head, Torso, Neck}) do
		Figure[v.Name] = v
	end
	local Values = {"Creator", "Mode", "Follow", "Target", "TargetPos", "Offset", "Damage", "MaxDistance"}
	for i, v in pairs(Values) do
		local Value = Child:FindFirstChild(v)
		if not Value then
			return
		end
		Figure[v] = Value
	end
	local HumanoidChanged = Humanoid.Changed:connect(function(Property)
		if Property == "Sit" and Humanoid.Sit then
			Humanoid.Sit = false
			Humanoid.Jump = true
		end
	end)
	local FigureRemoved = Child.Changed:connect(function(Property)
		if Property == "Parent" and not Child.Parent then
			for i, v in pairs(Figures) do
				if v == Figure then
					for ii, vv in pairs(v.Connections) do
						if vv then
							vv:disconnect()
						end
					end
					table.remove(Figures, i)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
	for i ,v in pairs({HumanoidChanged, FigureRemoved}) do
		table.insert(Figure.Connections, v)
	end
	for i, v in pairs(Child:GetChildren()) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			local TouchedConnection
			TouchedConnection = v.Touched:connect(function(Hit)
				if not Hit or not Hit.Parent or Figure.TouchDebounce then
					return
				end
				local Connected = false
				local ConnectedParts = v:GetConnectedParts()
				if #ConnectedParts <= 1 then
					return
				end
				for i, v in pairs(ConnectedParts) do
					if v == Torso then
						Connected = true
					end
				end
				if not Connected then
					return
				end
				local character = Hit.Parent
				if character:IsA("Accoutrement") then
					character = character.Parent
				end
				if character ~= Figure.Target.Value then
					return
				end
				local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
				local CreatorValue = Figure.Creator.Value
				if not CreatorValue then
					return
				end
				local CreatorPlayer = ((CreatorValue:IsA("Player") and CreatorValue) or Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(CreatorValue))
				if player then
					if player == CreatorPlayer then
						return
					end
					if player and CreatorPlayer and Functions.IsTeamMate(CreatorPlayer, player) then
						return
					end
				end
				local creator = character:FindFirstChild("Creator")
				if creator and creator:IsA("ObjectValue") and creator.Value == CreatorValue then
					return
				end
				local humanoid = character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
				if not humanoid or not humanoid:IsA("Humanoid") or humanoid.Health == 0 then
					return
				end
				Figure.TouchDebounce = true
				Functions.UntagHumanoid(humanoid)
				Functions.TagHumanoid(humanoid, CreatorPlayer)
				humanoid:TakeDamage(Figure.Damage.Value)
				wait(0.25)
				Figure.TouchDebounce = false
			end)
			table.insert(Figure.Connections, TouchedConnection)
		end
	end
	table.insert(Figures, Figure)
end

function SecureJump(Table)
	local Humanoid = Table.Humanoid
	local Torso = Table.HumanoidRootPart
	if not Humanoid or Humanoid.Jump or not Torso then
		return
	end
	local TargetPoint = Torso.Velocity.Unit
	local Blockage, BlockagePos = Functions.CastRay((Torso.CFrame + CFrame.new(Torso.Position, Vector3.new(TargetPoint.X, Torso.Position.Y, TargetPoint.Z)).lookVector * (Torso.Size.Z / 2)).p, Torso.CFrame.lookVector, (Torso.Size.Z * 2.5), {Figure, (((Creator and Creator.Value and Creator.Value:IsA("Player") and Creator.Value.Character) and Creator.Value.Character) or nil)}, false)
	local Jumpable = false
	if Blockage then
		Jumpable = true
		if Blockage:IsA("Terrain") then
			local CellPos = Blockage:WorldToCellPreferSolid((BlockagePos - Vector3.new(0, 2, 0)))
			local CellMaterial, CellShape, CellOrientation = Blockage:GetCell(CellPos.X, CellPos.Y, CellPos.Z)
			if CellMaterial == Enum.CellMaterial.Water then
				Jumpable = false
			end
		elseif Blockage.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
			Jumpable = false
		end
	end
	if Jumpable then
		Humanoid.Jump = true
	end
end

								local FollowDistance = (v.HumanoidRootPart.Position - FollowTorso.Position).Magnitude
								v.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = ((FollowDistance >= 10 and (16 * 2)) or 16)
								if FollowHumanoid and FollowHumanoid.Health > 0 and FollowTorso then

							local TargetCharacter = v.Target.Value
							local TargetDisabled = v.Target:FindFirstChild("Disabled")
							if not TargetDisabled or not TargetDisabled.Value then
								if TargetCharacter then
									local TargetHumanoid = TargetCharacter:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")

									local creator = TargetCharacter:FindFirstChild("Creator")

										local ChaseOffset = Vector3.new(((math.random() - 0.5) * 5), ((math.random() - 0.5) * 5), ((math.random() - 0.5) * 5))
										v.Humanoid:MoveTo((TargetTorso.CFrame * CFrame.new(ChaseOffset)).p)
									else
										v.Target.Value = nil
										v.Mode.Value = "Follow"
									end
								end
							end
						elseif v.Mode.Value == "Nothing" then
							if (Time - LastMove) >= 30 then
								v.Mode.Value = "Follow"
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end)
		end)

function Slerp(t, v1, v2)
	local om = math.acos(math.min(1, v1:Dot(v2)))
	return ((om < 0.01 and ((1 - t) * v1 + t * v2)) or ((math.sin((1 - t) * om) / math.sin(om)) * v1 + (math.sin(t * om) / math.sin(om)) * v2))
end

function TransformModel(Objects, Center, NewCFrame, Recurse)
	local Objects = ((type(Objects) ~= "table" and {Objects}) or Objects)
	for i, v in pairs(Objects) do
		if v:IsA("BasePart") then
			v.CFrame = NewCFrame:toWorldSpace(Center:toObjectSpace(v.CFrame))
		end
		if Recurse then
			TransformModel(v:GetChildren(), Center, NewCFrame, true)
		end
	end
end

function GetAllConnectedParts(Object)
	local Parts = {}
	local function GetConnectedParts(Object)
		for i, v in pairs(Object:GetConnectedParts()) do
			local Ignore = false
			for ii, vv in pairs(Parts) do
				if v == vv then
					Ignore = true
				end
			end
			if not Ignore then
				table.insert(Parts, v)
				GetConnectedParts(v)
			end
		end
	end
	GetConnectedParts(Object)
	return Parts
end

function BeginFlight()
	
	if not CurrentBalloon or not CurrentBalloon.Balloon or not CurrentBalloon.Balloon.Parent then
		return
	end
		
	local MainPart = CurrentBalloon.Balloon:FindFirstChild("MainPart")
	if not MainPart then
		return
	end
	
	Flying = true
	
	pcall(function()
		GuiClone.Frame.Message.Text = "Click and Hold to direct the Balloon in the" .. "\n" .. "direction you are looking. Holding with both" .. "\n".. "mouse buttons gives easy free flight."
	end)
	
	ControlBalloon()
	
end

function EndFlight()
	
	if CurrentBalloon and CurrentBalloon.Balloon.Parent then
		for i, v in pairs({CurrentBalloon.Fire1, CurrentBalloon.Fire2}) do
			if v and v.Parent then
				v.Enabled = false
			end
		end
	end
	
	Flying = false
	
	pcall(function()
		GuiClone.Frame.Message.Text = "Click to place a Balloon." .. "\n".. "Get into a Balloon to fly it."
	end)
	
end

function ControlBalloon()
	
	if not CurrentBalloon or not CurrentBalloon.Balloon.Parent or not CurrentBalloon.MainPart.Parent or not CurrentBalloon.BodyGyro.Parent or not CurrentBalloon.BodyVelocity.Parent then
		return
	end
	
	local MainPart = CurrentBalloon.MainPart
	local FlyingForce = CurrentBalloon.BodyVelocity
	local FlyingGyro = CurrentBalloon.BodyGyro
	local FirePart1 = CurrentBalloon.FirePart1
	local Fire1 = CurrentBalloon.Fire1
	local Fire2 = CurrentBalloon.Fire2
	
	local SoundPlaying = false	
	
	local BalloonMass = 0
	for i, v in pairs(GetAllConnectedParts(MainPart)) do
		BalloonMass = (BalloonMass + v:GetMass())
	end
	BalloonMass = (BalloonMass * 2 * 196.20)
	FlyingForce.maxForce = Vector3.new(BalloonMass, BalloonMass, BalloonMass)
	
	local CurrentVelocity = math.min(MaxSpeed, FlyingForce.velocity.magnitude)	
	
	local LastTime = tick()
	local DesiredFlightCFrame = MainPart.CFrame
	
	while ToolEquipped and Flying do
		local Now = tick()
		local Time = (Now - LastTime)
		LastTime = Now
		
		if Flying then
			
			local CoordinateFrame = InvokeClient("GetCamera", {Property = "CoordinateFrame"})
			local MoveDirection = (CoordinateFrame * CFrame.Angles(0.6, 0, 0))
			if MouseDown then
				local Theta = math.acos(DesiredFlightCFrame.lookVector:Dot(MoveDirection.lookVector))
				local Frac = math.min(0.7, (0.7 * Time / Theta))
				local Unit = Slerp(Frac, DesiredFlightCFrame.lookVector, MoveDirection.lookVector)
				DesiredFlightCFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(0, 0, 0), Unit)
				
				if CurrentVelocity < MaxSpeed then
					CurrentVelocity = math.min((CurrentVelocity + 8 * Time), MaxSpeed)
				end
			else
				if CurrentVelocity > 2 then
					CurrentVelocity = math.max(0, (CurrentVelocity - 3 * Time))
				end
			end
			
			local Direction = DesiredFlightCFrame.lookVector
			local DirectionXZ = Vector3.new(Direction.X, 0, Direction.Z).unit
			
			FlyingGyro.cframe = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(), DirectionXZ) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0) --CFrame.Angles(0, 0, (MainPart.RotVelocity.y / 3 * (1 - math.abs(Direction.Y) ^ 2)))
			
			if FirePart1 and FirePart1.Parent then
				local FireSound = FirePart1:FindFirstChild("FireSound")
				if FireSound then
					if Direction.y > 0 then
						if not SoundPlaying then
							SoundPlaying = true
							FireSound:Play()
						end
					else
						SoundPlaying = false
						FireSound:Stop()
					end
				end
			end
			for i, v in pairs({Fire1, Fire2}) do
				if v and v.Parent then
					v.Enabled = MouseDown --(Direction.y > 0 and CurrentVelocity > 2)
				end
			end
			local SlowDownFactor = math.abs(MainPart.RotVelocity.Y / 3)
			FlyingForce.velocity = (Direction.unit * (CurrentVelocity - SlowDownFactor) * (1 - Direction.Y ^ 2))
		end
		wait()
	end
end

function SetUpConnections()
	for i, v in pairs(Connections) do
		if v then
			v:disconnect()
		end
	end
	Connections = {}
	if CurrentBalloon and CurrentBalloon.Balloon then
		local Balloon = CurrentBalloon.Balloon
		local BalloonRemoved = Balloon.Changed:connect(function(Property)
			if Property == "Parent" and not Balloon.Parent then
				Handle.Transparency = 0
			end
		end)
		for i, v in pairs(Balloon:GetChildren()) do
			if v:IsA("Seat") then
				local SeatWeldAdded = v.ChildAdded:connect(function(Child)
					if Child:IsA("JointInstance") and Child.Name == "SeatWeld" and not Flying then
						if ((Child.Part0 and Child.Part0.Parent == Character) or (Child.Part1 and Child.Part1.Parent == Character)) then
							Seated = true
							BeginFlight()
						end
					end
				end)
				local SeatWeldRemoved = v.ChildRemoved:connect(function(Child)
					if Child:IsA("JointInstance") and Child.Name == "SeatWeld" and Flying then
						if ((Child.Part0 and Child.Part0.Parent == Character) or (Child.Part1 and Child.Part1.Parent == Character)) then
							Seated = false
							EndFlight()
						end
					end
				end)
				for i, v in pairs({BalloonRemoved, SeatWeldAdded, SeatWeldRemoved}) do
					if v then
						table.insert(Connections, v)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function CheckIfAlive()
	return (((Character and Character.Parent and Humanoid and Humanoid.Parent and Humanoid.Health > 0 and Torso and Torso.Parent and Player and Player.Parent) and true) or false)
end

function Equipped(Mouse)
	Character = Tool.Parent
	Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Character)
	Humanoid = Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
	Torso = Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not CheckIfAlive() then
		return
	end
	Spawn(function()
		local PlayerGui = Player:FindFirstChild("PlayerGui")
		if PlayerGui then
			GuiClone = Gui:Clone()
			GuiClone.Frame.Message.Text = "Click to create a Balloon." .. "\n" .. "Get into a Balloon to fly it."
			GuiClone.Parent = PlayerGui
		end
	end)
	Spawn(function()
		if CurrentBalloon and CurrentBalloon.Balloon.Parent then
			Handle.Transparency = 1
			if Seated then
				BeginFlight()
			end
		end
	end)
	ToolEquipped = true
end

function Unequipped()
	MouseDown = false
	EndFlight()
	if GuiClone and GuiClone.Parent then
		GuiClone:Destroy()
	end
	Handle.Transparency = 0
	ToolEquipped = false
end

function OnServerInvoke(player, mode, value)
	if player == Player and ToolEquipped and value and CheckIfAlive() then
		if mode == "MouseClick" then
			local Down = value.Down
			if Down then
				MouseDown = true
				if (tick() - DeployTick) > IdleDuration and (not CurrentBalloon or not CurrentBalloon.Balloon.Parent) then
					DeployTick = tick()
					Seated = false
					Flying = false
					Handle.Transparency = 1
					local MousePosition = InvokeClient("MousePosition")
					local Direction = CFrame.new(Torso.Position, MousePosition.Position)
					CurrentBalloon = CreateBalloon()
					local Balloon = CurrentBalloon.Balloon
					local MainPart = CurrentBalloon.MainPart
					TransformModel(Balloon, Balloon:GetModelCFrame(), ((Torso.CFrame + Direction.lookVector * 10) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, 0)), true)
					MainPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(Vector3.new(MainPart.Position.X, Torso.Position.Y, MainPart.Position.Z), Torso.Position)
					CurrentBalloon.BodyGyro.cframe = MainPart.CFrame
					Balloon.Parent = game:GetService("Workspace")
					SetUpConnections(CurrentBalloon)
				end
			else
				MouseDown = false
			end
		elseif mode == "KeyPress" then
			local Key = value.Key
			local ByteKey = string.byte(Key)
			local Down = value.Down
			if Key == "x" and Down then
				if CurrentBalloon and CurrentBalloon.Balloon.Parent then
					CurrentBalloon.Balloon:Destroy()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

function InvokeClient(Mode, Value)
	local ClientReturn = nil
	pcall(function()
		ClientReturn = ClientControl:InvokeClient(Player, Mode, Value)
	end)
	return ClientReturn
end

Tool.Changed:connect(function(Property)
	if Property == "Parent" and not Tool.Parent:IsA("Backpack") and not Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(Tool.Parent) then
		if CurrentBalloon and CurrentBalloon.Balloon.Parent then
			CurrentBalloon.Balloon:Destroy()
		end
	end
end)

ServerControl.OnServerInvoke = OnServerInvoke
Tool.Equipped:connect(Equipped)
Tool.Unequipped:connect(Unequipped)

function GetAllConnectedParts(Object)
	local Parts = {}
	local function GetConnectedParts(Object)
		for i, v in pairs(Object:GetConnectedParts()) do
			local Ignore = false
			for ii, vv in pairs(Parts) do
				if v == vv then
					Ignore = true
				end
			end
			if not Ignore then
				table.insert(Parts, v)
				GetConnectedParts(v)
			end
		end
	end
	GetConnectedParts(Object)
	return Parts
end

function IdleRemove()
	local CanRemove = true
	local RemoveCheck = Seated.Changed:connect(function()
		if Seated.Value then
			CanRemove = false
		end
	end)
	wait(IdleDuration)
	if RemoveCheck then
		RemoveCheck:disconnect()
	end
	if CanRemove then
		DestroyModel()
	end
end

Player.Changed:connect(function(Property)
	if Property == "Parent" and not Player.Parent then
		DestroyModel()
	elseif Property == "Character" and not Player.Character or not Player.Character.Parent then
		DestroyModel()
	end
end)

for i, v in pairs(Model:GetChildren()) do
	if v:IsA("Seat") then
		table.insert(Seats, v)
		v.ChildAdded:connect(function(Child)
			if Child:IsA("JointInstance") and Child.Name == "SeatWeld" then
				if ((Child.Part0 and Child.Part0.Parent == Character) or (Child.Part1 and Child.Part1.Parent == Character)) then
					Seated.Value = true
				end
			end
		end)
		v.ChildRemoved:connect(function(Child)
			if Child:IsA("JointInstance") and Child.Name == "SeatWeld" then
				if ((Child.Part0 and Child.Part0.Parent == Character) or (Child.Part1 and Child.Part1.Parent == Character)) then
					Seated.Value = false
				end
			end
		end)
	end
end

			IdleRemove()

	end)

Spawn(function() --Broken monitor; Will determine whether or not the balloon is intact or in pieces.
	while true do
		if not MainPart.Parent or not Balloon.Parent or (not BalloonWeld.Parent or not BalloonWeld.Part0 or not BalloonWeld.Part0.Parent or not BalloonWeld.Part1 or not BalloonWeld.Part1.Parent) then --The base or balloon of the model is missing, so the balloon is removed.
			DestroyModel()
			break
		end
		local ConnectedParts = GetAllConnectedParts(MainPart)
		for i, v in pairs(Seats) do
			local SeatWelded = false
			for ii, vv in pairs(ConnectedParts) do
				if v == vv then
					SeatWelded = true
				end
			end
			if not SeatWelded then --If neither seat is attached to the balloon, it is unusable, therefore it is removed.
				table.remove(Seats, i)
			end
			if #Seats == 0 then
				DestroyModel()
				break
			end
		end
		wait(1)
	end
end)

WheelSize = 3--diameter of the wheel

--When you are editing the car, make sure that the Left, Right, and Base parts are in a 
--straight line, and in the orientation the models comes with, or they won't be where you expect
--them to be at all!

motorSpeed = 0.05 -- a typical number is 0.1 but lower is better if you get weird behavior


--don't touch below, very delicate
car = script.Parent.Parent

Base = car:FindFirstChild("Base")
Left = car:FindFirstChild("Left")
Right = car:FindFirstChild("Right")

function MakeDoor(hinge,door,hingeOffset,doorOffset)
	local doorMotor = Instance.new("Motor",car)
	doorMotor.Name = hinge.Name.."Motor"
	doorMotor.Part0 = door
	doorMotor.Part1 = hinge
	doorMotor.C0 = doorOffset
	doorMotor.C1 = hingeOffset
	doorMotor.MaxVelocity = 0.05
	door.CanCollide = true
	local doorDebounce = false
	door.Touched:connect(function(it)
		if not doorDebounce and it.Parent and it.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(it.Parent) then
			doorDebounce = true
			door.CanCollide = false
			doorMotor.DesiredAngle =  math.pi/3
			wait(1.5)
			doorMotor.DesiredAngle = 0
			wait(0.5)
			door.CanCollide = true
			doorDebounce = false
		end
	end)
end
function MakeWeldDoor(hinge,door)
	local doorMotor = Instance.new("Motor6D",car)
	doorMotor.Name = hinge.Name.."Motor"
	doorMotor.Part0 = door
	doorMotor.Part1 = hinge
	doorMotor.C1 = hinge.CFrame:inverse()*door.CFrame
	door.CanCollide = false
end

function GetCFrame(object)--we'll get a CFrame value out of a CFrameValue or a StringValue formatted like a CFrame
	if object:IsA("CFrameValue") then--if someone is using a CFrame value then we'll just pull the value directly
		return object.Value
	elseif object:IsA("StringValue") then--added functionality for this because I dislike interfacing with CFrame values
		local cframe = nil
		pcall(function()--using pcall because i'm lazy
			cframe = CFrame.new(object.Value:match("(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+)"))
			--if you print your CFrame and paste it into the string value, this will find that out and use it properly
		end)
		return cframe
	end
end

for _,h in pairs (car:GetChildren()) do
	if h:IsA("Motor6D") then--make sure we start with a blank slate
		h:Destroy()
	end
end

for _,i in pairs (car:GetChildren()) do
	if i:IsA("BasePart") and i.Name:find("DoorHinge") then-- found a door with regex!
		local DoorID = i.Name:match("DoorHinge(.*)")--haha regex is fun
		local MatchingDoor = car:FindFirstChild("Door"..DoorID)--can we use our regex powers to find a matching door?
		if MatchingDoor then-- yay we found one!
			local DoorCFrameValue = MatchingDoor:FindFirstChild("DoorCFrame")
			local HingeCFrameValue = MatchingDoor:FindFirstChild("HingeCFrame")
			if DoorCFrameValue and HingeCFrameValue then
				local doorCFrame = GetCFrame(DoorCFrameValue)
				local hingeCFrame = GetCFrame(HingeCFrameValue)
				if doorCFrame and hingeCFrame then
					MakeDoor(i,MatchingDoor,hingeCFrame,doorCFrame)
				else
					MakeWeldDoor(i,MatchingDoor)
				end
			else
				MakeWeldDoor(i,MatchingDoor)
			end
		end
	end
end

if Base then
	if Left then
		leftMotor = Instance.new("Motor6D", car)
		leftMotor.Name = "LeftMotor"

		leftMotor.Part1 = Base
		leftMotor.C0 = CFrame.new(-WheelSize/2-Left.Size.x/2,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,-math.pi/2)
		leftMotor.C1 = CFrame.new(Base.Size.x/2+Left.Size.x+WheelSize/2,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,math.pi/2)
		leftMotor.MaxVelocity = motorSpeed
	end
	if Right then
		rightMotor = Instance.new("Motor6D", car)
		rightMotor.Name = "RightMotor"
		rightMotor.Part0 = Right
		rightMotor.Part1 = Base
		rightMotor.C0 = CFrame.new(-WheelSize/2-Right.Size.x/2,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,math.pi/2)
		rightMotor.C1 = CFrame.new(-Base.Size.x/2-Right.Size.x-WheelSize/2,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,math.pi/2)
		rightMotor.MaxVelocity = motorSpeed
	end
end

function CalculatePitch()--this returns the pitch that the engine should be at when its travelling
	return 1+RemoteControlled.Velocity.magnitude/100
end

Configuration = car:FindFirstChild("Configuration")-- so you can change the stats of the car
if Configuration then-- if we found an object named Configuration in the car then do this stuff:
	local ReverseSpeedValue = Configuration:FindFirstChild("Reverse Speed")-- do we have a reverse speed?
	if ReverseSpeedValue ~= nil then
		if type(ReverseSpeedValue.Value) == "number" then
			reverseSpeed = ReverseSpeedValue.Value
		end
		ReverseSpeedValue.Changed:connect(function()-- level 1 scripting: go
			if ReverseSpeedValue.Parent ~= nil then-- this script works, but there are some things
				if type(ReverseSpeedValue.Value) == "number" then-- to make it look a little better
					reverseSpeed = ReverseSpeedValue.Value
					UpdateVehicle()
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	local ForwardsSpeedValue = Configuration:FindFirstChild("Forwards Speed")
	if ForwardsSpeedValue then
		if type(ForwardsSpeedValue.Value) == "number" then
			forwardsSpeed = ForwardsSpeedValue.Value
		end
		ForwardsSpeedValue.Changed:connect(function()-- level 2 scripting: go
			if ForwardsSpeedValue.Parent then -- asking if something 'is' is the same as 
				if ForwardsSpeedValue.Value then-- asking if it is "~= nil"
					forwardsSpeed = ForwardsSpeedValue.Value
					UpdateVehicle()
				end		
			end
		end)
	end
	
	local AllowFlippingValue = Configuration:FindFirstChild("Allow Flipping")
	if AllowFlippingValue then
		if type(AllowFlippingValue.Value)=="boolean" then
			allowFlipping = AllowFlippingValue.Value
		end											-- level 3 scripting: go
		AllowFlippingValue.Changed:connect(function()-- the script executes a chain of 
			if AllowFlippingValue.Parent and type(AllowFlippingValue.Value) == "boolean" then-- "and" statements in the order they
				allowFlipping = AllowFlippingValue.Value-- come in so if the first one isn't "true" then
														-- it will skip the rest
			end
		end)
	end
	local TorqueValue = Configuration:FindFirstChild("Torque")
	if TorqueValue then
		if type(TorqueValue.Value)=="number" and RemoteControlled then
			RemoteControlled.Torque = TorqueValue.Value
		end
		TorqueValue.Changed:connect(function()
			if TorqueValue.Parent and type(TorqueValue.Value) == "number" and RemoteControlled then

		end)

seat.ChildAdded:connect(function(it)-- something was added to our seat!
	if it:IsA("Weld") and it.Name == "SeatWeld" then-- is it the kind of thing players use to sit with?
		Player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(it.Part1.Parent)-- is there a player attached to it?
		if Player then-- hooray! a player WAS attached to the seat weld. It's time to start the car!
			if car.DriverLocked.Value and Player.Name ~= car.Owner.Value then
				wait(1/30)
				if it and it.Part1 and it.Part1.Parent:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") then
					it.Part1.Parent.Humanoid.Jump = true
					return
				end
			end
			script.CarSteering:Clone().Parent = Player.Backpack-- for better driving
			RemoteControlled.MaxSpeed = 0-- not yet little child
			if engineBlock and engineBlock:FindFirstChild("Starting") and engineBlock.Starting:IsA("Sound") then
				engineBlock.Starting:Play()
			end
			if engineBlock and engineBlock:FindFirstChild("Stopping") and engineBlock.Stopping:IsA("Sound") then
				engineBlock.Stopping:Stop()
			end
			wait(StartTime)-- just in case you use different starting sound effects
			if it.Parent ~= seat then-- DID OUR LOVELY PLAYER LEAVE WHILE WE WEREN'T LOOKING???????
				byebye()--maybe they did, so it's time to shut down the car
			else-- they didn't leave!
				seat:SetNetworkOwner(Player)
				lightsOn = true-- turn on the lights
				carRunning = true-- turn on the car
				updatelights()-- make sure we turn on the lights
				UpdateVehicle()-- maybe they're in a hurry, so we better check if they have their foot on the gas
				if engineBlock and engineBlock:FindFirstChild("Running") and engineBlock.Running:IsA("Sound") then
					engineBlock.Running:Play()
					engineBlock.Running.Pitch = CalculatePitch()
				end
			end
		end
	end
end)

seat.ChildRemoved:connect(function(it)--did an object get removed?
	if it:isA("Weld") and it.Name == "SeatWeld" then-- if it's a weld and named like a seat weld
		byebye()-- time to shut down the car
		seat:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto()
	end
end)

function byebye()
	if engineBlock and carRunning then-- remember scripting level 3? that applies to below:
		if engineBlock and engineBlock:FindFirstChild("Stopping") and engineBlock.Stopping:IsA("Sound") then
			engineBlock.Stopping:Play()-- where if it didn't do it like that, the above would error!
			wait(0.1)					-- because engineBlock.Stopping would not exist, so :IsA() is
		end								-- "not a valid member"
		if engineBlock and engineBlock:FindFirstChild("Running") and engineBlock.Running:IsA("Sound") then
			engineBlock.Running:Stop()-- WE MUST NOT STOP
		end
		if engineBlock and engineBlock:FindFirstChild("Starting") and engineBlock.Starting:IsA("Sound") then
			engineBlock.Starting:Stop()-- THIS SCRIPT IS BREAK-PROOF >:U
		end
	end
	RemoteControlled.MaxSpeed = 0--make sure that the car doesn't drive off without us
	carRunning = false
	lightsOn = false
	updatelights()--turn the lights off
	UpdateVehicle()--make sure the car stops now that it's off
end

ReverseLight = {}--These light up when you reverse

	if i.Name == "RearBulb" then-- you can have any number of these items you want
		table.insert(RearBulb,i)-- and you don't have to change the script one bit!
	elseif i.Name == "RearLight" then
		table.insert(RearLight,i.SpotLight)
	elseif i.Name == "FrontLight" then
		table.insert(FrontLight,i.SpotLight)
	elseif i.Name == "ReverseLight" then

	elseif i.Name == "FrontBulb" then
		table.insert(FrontBulb,i)
	elseif i.Name == "ReverseBulb" then
		table.insert(ReverseBulb,i)
	elseif i:IsA("VehicleSeat") and i  ~= seat then

function updatelights()-- this turns the lights on and off based on the lightsOn value
	for _,i in pairs (RearLight) do
		i.Enabled = lightsOn
	end
	for _,i in pairs (FrontLight) do
		i.Enabled = lightsOn
	end
	for _,i in pairs (FrontBulb) do
		SurfaceGuiStandard(i,lightsOn)
	end
	for _,g in pairs (RearBulb) do
		SurfaceGuiBrightness(g,lightsOn,seat.Throttle == 0)
	end
end

flippingDebounce = false-- a debounce is a simple way of preventing a function from
						-- being called multiple times while it's still running
function Flip()
	if not flippingDebounce then-- here's how it works: the function checks if the debounce is off
		flippingDebounce = true-- if it's on, then the function stops, but if it's off, set it to true
		local bodypos = Instance.new("BodyPosition",seat)-- so we get uninterupted function fun
		bodypos.maxForce = Vector3.new(100000,10000000,100000)
		bodypos.position = seat.Position + Vector3.new(0,2,0)
		local bodygyro = Instance.new("BodyGyro",seat)
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(bodypos, 3)-- this makes sure that the flippy bit
		game:GetService("Debris"):AddItem(bodygyro, 3)-- deletes itself automatically
		wait(3)
		flippingDebounce = false-- when we are done with our fun, allow the function to work again
	end
end

function SurfaceGuiStandard(part,on)-- this makes it so the lights turn on or off
	for _,i in pairs (part:GetChildren()) do
		if i:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
			i.Enabled = on
		end
	end
end

function SurfaceGuiBrightness(part,on,bright)-- this is so the brake lights dim when we drive
	for _,i in pairs (part:GetChildren()) do
		if i:IsA("SurfaceGui") then
			i.Enabled = on
			if i:FindFirstChild("Frame") and i.Frame:IsA("Frame") then
				i.Frame.Transparency = bright and 0 or 0.5-- scripting level 4: go
			end-- for simple statements, you can have a boolean value decide between 2 values
			-- which is the same as writing	
			-- "if bright then
			--		i.Frame.Transparency = 0
			--	else
			--		i.Frame.Transparency = 0.5
			-- end"
			--but instead of "then" and "else", you use "and" and "or"
		end
	end
end

hornDebounce = false
function Honk()-- if you are reading this then congratulations! you win a prize!
	if hornDebounce then return end-- unfortunately, I could not think of a way
	if engineBlock and engineBlock:FindFirstChild("Horn") and engineBlock.Horn:IsA("Sound") then
		hornDebounce = true-- to allow people to be able to honk the horn for both PC and mobile
		engineBlock.horn:Play()	-- in an unobtrusive way. Sorry! :(
		print("beep beep") -- UristMcSparks, the guy in charge of the toolbox, doesn't want print statements
		wait(0.5)-- but since this is a secret, lets keep it between you and me, OK?
		engineBlock.horn:Stop()
		hornDebounce = false
	end
end

function UpdateVehicle()-- this is for the brake lights and speed and stuff like that
	if seat.Torque ~= 0 and type(seat.Torque) == "number" and RemoteControlled then
		RemoteControlled.Torque = math.abs(seat.Torque)
		seat.Torque = 0
	else
		seat.Torque = 0
	end
	if seat.Throttle == 1 and carRunning then-- if we're going forwards
		RemoteControlled.MaxSpeed = forwardsSpeed-- give it forwards speed
	elseif seat.Throttle == -1 and carRunning then-- if we're going backwards
		RemoteControlled.MaxSpeed = reverseSpeed-- give it backwards speed
	else
		RemoteControlled.MaxSpeed = 0 -- otherwise, give it 0 speed
	end
	if workspace.FilteringEnabled and RemoteControlled and RemoteControlled.Parent then--the idea from scripting level 2 applies to false as well
		RemoteControlled.Throttle = seat.Throttle-- that is, it also works for "~= false"
	end-- the reason this line exists is to prevent the server from doing something the client
	-- is already doing.
	for _,h in pairs (ReverseLight) do-- all these loops below are just updating the lights
		h.Enabled = lightsOn and seat.Throttle == -1
	end
	for _,i in pairs (ReverseBulb) do
		SurfaceGuiStandard(i,lightsOn and seat.Throttle == -1)
	end
	for _,j in pairs (RearLight) do
		j.Brightness = 4-math.abs(seat.Throttle)*3
	end
	for _,k in pairs (RearBulb) do
		SurfaceGuiBrightness(k,lightsOn,seat.Throttle == 0)
	end
end

seat.Changed:connect(UpdateVehicle)-- this is so that when someone drives the car
								   -- the brake and reverse lights change
								   -- and the speed of the car changes

while true do
	for i = 1, 60 do--60/30 == 2, 2 seconds between deciding if it's upside down
		wait()-- we want the steering and sfx to update as many times a second as we can
		if workspace.FilteringEnabled then
			if car:FindFirstChild("LeftMotor") then
				car.LeftMotor.DesiredAngle = seat.Steer*math.rad(40-RemoteControlled.Velocity.magnitude/4)
			end
			if car:FindFirstChild("RightMotor") then
				car.RightMotor.DesiredAngle = seat.Steer*math.rad(40-RemoteControlled.Velocity.magnitude/4)
			end
		end
		-- below: make sure there's a sound to play
		if RemoteControlled and carRunning and engineBlock and engineBlock:FindFirstChild("Running") and engineBlock.Running:IsA("Sound") then
			engineBlock.Running.Pitch = CalculatePitch()-- and make sure that the car is on before trying
												-- to make sure the engine sounds good
		end
	end
	--         V this allows people to say if they want the car to flip over or not
	if allowFlipping and (seat.CFrame*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,0)).lookVector.Y < 0.2 then--am I upside down?
		Flip()--flip the car right side up
		
		-- as a fun experiment, see what happens if you replace "Flip()" with "Spawn(Flip)"
		-- and see what the difference is when you drive the car off the baseplate
		-- if you did it right, you'll notice that the engine sound changes differently!
	end
end

WheelSize = 3--diameter of the wheel

--When you are editing the car, make sure that the Left, Right, and Base parts are in a 
--straight line, and in the orientation the models comes with, or they won't be where you expect
--them to be at all!

motorSpeed = 0.05 -- a typical number is 0.1 but lower is better if you get weird behavior


--don't touch below, very delicate
car = script.Parent.Parent

Base = car:FindFirstChild("Base")
Left = car:FindFirstChild("Left")
Right = car:FindFirstChild("Right")

function MakeDoor(hinge,door,hingeOffset,doorOffset)
	local doorMotor = Instance.new("Motor",car)
	doorMotor.Name = hinge.Name.."Motor"
	doorMotor.Part0 = door
	doorMotor.Part1 = hinge
	doorMotor.C0 = doorOffset
	doorMotor.C1 = hingeOffset
	doorMotor.MaxVelocity = 0.05
	door.CanCollide = true
	local doorDebounce = false
	door.Touched:connect(function(it)
		if not doorDebounce and it.Parent and it.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" and game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayerFromCharacter(it.Parent) then
			doorDebounce = true
			door.CanCollide = false
			doorMotor.DesiredAngle =  math.pi/3
			wait(1.5)
			doorMotor.DesiredAngle = 0
			wait(0.5)
			door.CanCollide = true
			doorDebounce = false
		end
	end)
end
function MakeWeldDoor(hinge,door)
	local doorMotor = Instance.new("Motor6D",car)
	doorMotor.Name = hinge.Name.."Motor"
	doorMotor.Part0 = door
	doorMotor.Part1 = hinge
	doorMotor.C1 = hinge.CFrame:inverse()*door.CFrame
	door.CanCollide = false
end

function GetCFrame(object)--we'll get a CFrame value out of a CFrameValue or a StringValue formatted like a CFrame
	if object:IsA("CFrameValue") then--if someone is using a CFrame value then we'll just pull the value directly
		return object.Value
	elseif object:IsA("StringValue") then--added functionality for this because I dislike interfacing with CFrame values
		local cframe = nil
		pcall(function()--using pcall because i'm lazy
			cframe = CFrame.new(object.Value:match("(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+),(.+)"))
			--if you print your CFrame and paste it into the string value, this will find that out and use it properly
		end)
		return cframe
	end
end

for _,h in pairs (car:GetChildren()) do
	if h:IsA("Motor6D") then--make sure we start with a blank slate
		h:Destroy()
	end
end

for _,i in pairs (car:GetChildren()) do
	if i:IsA("BasePart") and i.Name:find("DoorHinge") then-- found a door with regex!
		local DoorID = i.Name:match("DoorHinge(.*)")--haha regex is fun
		local MatchingDoor = car:FindFirstChild("Door"..DoorID)--can we use our regex powers to find a matching door?
		if MatchingDoor then-- yay we found one!
			local DoorCFrameValue = MatchingDoor:FindFirstChild("DoorCFrame")
			local HingeCFrameValue = MatchingDoor:FindFirstChild("HingeCFrame")
			if DoorCFrameValue and HingeCFrameValue then
				local doorCFrame = GetCFrame(DoorCFrameValue)
				local hingeCFrame = GetCFrame(HingeCFrameValue)
				if doorCFrame and hingeCFrame then
					MakeDoor(i,MatchingDoor,hingeCFrame,doorCFrame)
				else
					MakeWeldDoor(i,MatchingDoor)
				end
			else
				MakeWeldDoor(i,MatchingDoor)
			end
		end
	end
end

if Base then
	if Left then
		leftMotor = Instance.new("Motor6D", car)
		leftMotor.Name = "LeftMotor"
		leftMotor.Part0 = Left
		leftMotor.Part1 = Base
		leftMotor.C0 = CFrame.new(-WheelSize/2-Left.Size.x/2,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,-math.pi/2)
		leftMotor.C1 = CFrame.new(Base.Size.x/2+Left.Size.x+WheelSize/2,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,math.pi/2)
		leftMotor.MaxVelocity = motorSpeed
	end
	if Right then
		rightMotor = Instance.new("Motor6D", car)
		rightMotor.Name = "RightMotor"
		rightMotor.Part0 = Right
		rightMotor.Part1 = Base
		rightMotor.C0 = CFrame.new(-WheelSize/2-Right.Size.x/2,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,math.pi/2)
		rightMotor.C1 = CFrame.new(-Base.Size.x/2-Right.Size.x-WheelSize/2,0,0)*CFrame.Angles(math.pi/2,0,math.pi/2)
		rightMotor.MaxVelocity = motorSpeed
	end
end

Player = nil

forwardsSpeed = 60--if you removed the Configuration folder, it defaults to this speed forwards
reverseSpeed = 20--if you removed the Configuration folder, it defaults to this speed backwards
allowFlipping = true--if you removed the Configuration folder, it defaults to automatically flipping
StartTime = 1.2--how long (in seconds) the car should wait before starting up. This is dependant on the starting sfx

engineBlock = car:FindFirstChild("EngineBlock")--maybe someone doesn't like sound?

lightsOn = false-- whether or not the lights turn on

function CalculatePitch()--this returns the pitch that the engine should be at when its travelling
	return 1+RemoteControlled.Velocity.magnitude/100
end

Configuration = car:FindFirstChild("Configuration")-- so you can change the stats of the car
if Configuration then-- if we found an object named Configuration in the car then do this stuff:
	local ReverseSpeedValue = Configuration:FindFirstChild("Reverse Speed")-- do we have a reverse speed?
	if ReverseSpeedValue ~= nil then
		if type(ReverseSpeedValue.Value) == "number" then
			reverseSpeed = ReverseSpeedValue.Value
		end
		ReverseSpeedValue.Changed:connect(function()-- level 1 scripting: go
			if ReverseSpeedValue.Parent ~= nil then-- this script works, but there are some things
				if type(ReverseSpeedValue.Value) == "number" then-- to make it look a little better
					reverseSpeed = ReverseSpeedValue.Value
					UpdateVehicle()
				end
			end
		end)
	end
	local ForwardsSpeedValue = Configuration:FindFirstChild("Forwards Speed")
	if ForwardsSpeedValue then
		if type(ForwardsSpeedValue.Value) == "number" then
			forwardsSpeed = ForwardsSpeedValue.Value
		end
		ForwardsSpeedValue.Changed:connect(function()-- level 2 scripting: go
			if ForwardsSpeedValue.Parent then -- asking if something 'is' is the same as 
				if ForwardsSpeedValue.Value then-- asking if it is "~= nil"
					forwardsSpeed = ForwardsSpeedValue.Value
					UpdateVehicle()
				end		
			end
		end)
	end
	
	local AllowFlippingValue = Configuration:FindFirstChild("Allow Flipping")
	if AllowFlippingValue then
		if type(AllowFlippingValue.Value)=="boolean" then
			allowFlipping = AllowFlippingValue.Value
		end											-- level 3 scripting: go
		AllowFlippingValue.Changed:connect(function()-- the script executes a chain of 
			if AllowFlippingValue.Parent and type(AllowFlippingValue.Value) == "boolean" then-- "and" statements in the order they
				allowFlipping = AllowFlippingValue.Value-- come in so if the first one isn't "true" then
														-- it will skip the rest
			end
		end)
	end
	local TorqueValue = Configuration:FindFirstChild("Torque")
	if TorqueValue then
		if type(TorqueValue.Value)=="number" and RemoteControlled then
			RemoteControlled.Torque = TorqueValue.Value
		end
		TorqueValue.Changed:connect(function()
			if TorqueValue.Parent and type(TorqueValue.Value) == "number" and RemoteControlled then
				RemoteControlled.Torque = TorqueValue.Value
			end
		end)
	end
end

	RemoteControlled = nil-- no food 4 u!
